fields.description: Kennzahl that takes the base of a voucher booking tax on the tax accounts of this check but nothing on its base accounts. Steuerbote reads the base from the other lines of the voucher, or from the tax when they do not show it. Empty: such a voucher fails the check.
fields.label: Kz of the Base Without Base Account

fields.description: Kennzahl that takes the base of such a voucher instead when its supplier is established in another member state and the supply is a service under § 3a (2) UStG (§ 13b (1) UStG), by the country of the supplier or the classification under § 13b UStG below. Needs the Kz of the base without base account for every other voucher. Empty: every such voucher takes that Kennzahl.
fields.label: Kz for Suppliers in Other Member States
